name: Radar scan reveal
looks: Concentric rings sit centred on a bright anchor dot, like a radar display. Small dots light up one at a time at scattered positions inside the rings as a thin sweeping line or wedge of light passes slowly around, each dot brightening the instant the sweep crosses it.
build: Rings are static low-opacity SVG circles; each signal dot sits at a seeded (r, theta) position and fades/scales in once the sweep's current angle passes its theta; the sweep rotates continuously, linear, no easing. A detected dot can grow a short connecting line to a small label card.
sound: A soft, continuous low sweep tone, a distinct ping each time the sweep lands on a dot.
prompt: Centre concentric rings on a bright anchor dot and rotate a thin sweeping line slowly around them, lighting up small scattered dots one at a time exactly as the sweep crosses each one, like a radar always watching and finding new signals.
